gloss: early evening, early part of the night

definitions.gloss: early evening, early part of the night
definitions.explanation: The period shortly after sunset when the night has just begun, typically around 7-9 PM.

examples.japanese: まだ{宵|よい}の{口|くち}だ。
{宵|よい}の{口|くち}から{飲|の}み{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: We started drinking from early evening.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{宵|よい}の{口|くち}は{涼|すず}しくて{気持|きも}ちがいい。
examples.english: Early summer evenings are cool and pleasant.

notes:
USAGE NOTE:
Often used to suggest that the night is still young and there's plenty of time left, especially in social contexts like drinking parties.

RELATED TERMS:
- {宵|よい}: evening (literary)
- {夜|よる}: night (general term)
